seo.title: Analytics for Startups, Open Source & Affordable
seo.description: OpenPanel gives startups product analytics without enterprise pricing. Track events, funnels, retention, and user behavior from $2.50/mo or self-host free. No cookies, GDPR compliant.

hero.heading: Analytics for startups
hero.subheading: Get the product analytics you need to grow, without the enterprise price tag. Events, funnels, retention and user profiles from $2.50 a month. Self-host for free when budgets are tight.

problem.title: Why most analytics tools fail startups
problem.intro: The tools that have the features you need are priced for enterprises. The affordable ones lack the depth to drive real product decisions.

items.title: Mixpanel and Amplitude get expensive fast
items.description: Event-based pricing sounds fine at 10K events, but startups grow. At 1M events you're looking at $300–800/month, money better spent on product development.

items.title: Google Analytics doesn't show you user behavior
items.description: GA4 tracks pageviews and sessions, but can't tell you which users completed onboarding, where they dropped off in your funnel, or why retention is falling.

items.title: Privacy compliance is a headache
items.description: Cookie consent banners hurt conversion rates. GDPR fines can be existential for early-stage companies. Most analytics tools make compliance your problem, not theirs.

items.title: Vendor lock-in limits your options
items.description: Closed-source tools own your data. Migrating away means losing historical analytics. With no export path, you're stuck paying whatever they charge.

features.title: Everything you need to understand your users
features.intro: OpenPanel combines web analytics and product analytics in one tool. No need to pay for two separate platforms.

items.title: Event tracking
items.description: Track any user action with one call. Button clicks, sign-ups, purchases: one line per event, from the web, your app or your backend.

items.title: Funnel analysis
items.description: See where users drop off in your signup flow, onboarding, or checkout. Identify the step costing you the most conversions.

items.title: Retention analysis
items.description: See how many users come back after week 1, week 2 and week 4 in a cohort grid, with a weighted average that ignores weeks that have not happened yet.

items.title: User profiles
items.description: Every event a user triggered, their sessions, their properties and their revenue. Turn on session replay to watch a session next to its events.

items.title: Realtime dashboard
items.description: See events as they happen. Launch a feature and watch adoption. Run a campaign and watch conversions land.

items.title: Web analytics
items.description: Pageviews, referrers, UTM campaigns, devices, countries, the standard web analytics you expect, included out of the box.

items.title: Revenue tracking
items.description: Send the amount with the event and see revenue per user, per source and per campaign. Know what is making money.

items.title: Cookieless tracking
items.description: No cookies means no consent banner, better conversion and cleaner data. Cloud data is hosted in Germany with a DPA included.

items.title: Self-hosting option
items.description: Run OpenPanel on a $20 a month VPS when Cloud costs matter. Docker Compose, one install script, the full product with no event limits, releases a month or two behind Cloud.

benefits.title: Why startups choose OpenPanel
benefits.intro: Built for teams that need answers from their data without burning through their runway.

items.title: Predictable pricing that grows with you
items.description: Flat tiers from $2.50 to $900 a month. No per-seat fees, no surprise overages. Know what you will pay as you scale.

items.title: All features included at every tier
items.description: Funnels, retention, user profiles, replay, realtime: everything is available from day one. No upsells, no feature gates.

items.title: Self-host to cut costs to near zero
items.description: Self-hosting is the full product, free. Run it on your own infrastructure when you need to keep spend near zero.

items.title: Open source means no lock-in
items.description: AGPL-3.0 licensed. Your data is yours. Fork it, extend it, export it or migrate away; you are never stuck.

items.title: Set up in under 10 minutes
items.description: Add a script tag or install an SDK. Page views track automatically. Ship analytics and get back to building.

items.title: Privacy-first by default
items.description: Cookieless tracking and EU-only hosting mean you don't need a lawyer to figure out GDPR compliance.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions from startup teams evaluating OpenPanel.

items.question: How much does OpenPanel cost for a typical startup?
items.answer: Most early-stage startups land between $2.50 and $20 a month. At 100K events a month, a common seed-stage level, you pay $20 a month. Self-hosting is free; your only cost is the server.

items.question: Can I switch from Mixpanel or Amplitude?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel uses the same event-based model, so migrating is mostly renaming mixpanel.track() or amplitude.track() to op.track(). Built-in importers bring your Mixpanel or Amplitude history in through their export APIs.

items.question: What happens when I outgrow the free self-hosted version?
items.answer: Nothing, the self-hosted version has no usage limits. As your traffic grows, you may need to scale your server, but OpenPanel itself doesn't charge anything for self-hosting regardless of volume.

items.question: Is OpenPanel GDPR compliant?
items.answer: Yes. Cookieless tracking by default, so no cookie consent banner for analytics under GDPR. Cloud data is stored in Germany with a DPA included. Self-hosting gives you complete control over data location.

items.question: How does OpenPanel compare to PostHog?
items.answer: PostHog offers more tools (feature flags, experiments, error tracking) but is more complex and more expensive at scale. OpenPanel focuses on core analytics, events, funnels, retention, profiles, replay and AI observability, at a fraction of the cost. If you need a Swiss Army knife, choose PostHog. If you need focused product analytics, choose OpenPanel.

items.question: Do I need both Google Analytics and OpenPanel?
items.answer: No. OpenPanel includes web analytics (pageviews, referrers, UTM campaigns, devices, countries) alongside product analytics. For most startups, OpenPanel replaces both GA4 and a product analytics tool like Mixpanel.

items.question: What SDKs are available?
items.answer: SDKs for the web, Node, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Astro, Remix, Express, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Python, Ruby and Rust, plus community Flutter and PHP packages. There is also a script tag for zero-build setups and a REST API for everything else.

items.question: Can I track mobile apps?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel has SDKs for React Native, Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS). The same events, funnels and user profiles work across web and mobile.
